title: Jimmy Kimmel Gives JD Vance A ‘Hot Lead’ For His ‘Ridiculous’ New Job
text:

 News Finance More Mail Search the web Advertisement Advertisement Return to homepage Jimmy Kimmel Gives JD Vance A ‘Hot Lead’ For His ‘Ridiculous’ New Job
 Elyse Wanshel Updated Fri, 13 November 2026 at 8:27 pm UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. On Thursday, Jimmy Kimmel roasted Vice President JD Vance while talking about the new job President Donald Trump just gave him: rooting out corruption in blue states. During his opening monologue, Kimmel managed to emphasize the silliness of the vice president's new assignment by making another Trump goon the actual punchline.
 The comedian began by talking about how just earlier this week, Trump tasked Vance with the much meatier role of negotiating an end to the Iran war .
 Buzz: 'Nobody Wants You!': Jimmy Kimmel Demands That Trump Resign After Brutal Election Loss 
 "That's right. The guy who had trouble negotiating the purchase of a donut was going to meet with the Iranians and settle this war," Kimmel quipped.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Yet, on Thursday morning, Trump announced via Truth Social that Vance had been redirected to "focus his complete and total attention on the Massive Corruption and Crime taking place in Democrat run Cities and States."
 Kimmel felt he knew exactly why Vance got demoted, and decided to "translate" Trump's reasoning.
 President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance salute during a ceremony in honor of Veterans Day at Arlington National Cemetery on Nov. 11.Kevin Dietsch via Getty Images
 "Trump realized, 'Oh, no. If Vance is successful, he will get the credit for ending this war.' And that's Trump's nightmare," Kimmel said.
 "So he moved him. He put him in charge of rooting out corruption, which is so ridiculous for so many reasons," Kimmel continued. "One of them being Trump telling you to root out corruption is like Colonel Sanders telling you to root out cholesterol."
 Politics: Jimmy Kimmel Burns Trump Diplomats With Blistering Herpes Comparison After Iran Demands Vance 
 The host moved on to say that if Vance is looking for corruption, Kimmel knows exactly where he can start.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Last year, the Justice Department dropped a criminal bribery investigation into border czar Tom Homan . Homan was being investigated for reportedly accepting $50,000 in cash from undercover FBI agents posing as businessmen during a 2024 sting operation involving potential government contracts.
 Like this article? Keep independent journalism alive. Support HuffPost . 
 White House border czar Tom Homan takes a question from members of the media as he walks towards the West Wing of the White House following a television interview on May 29, 2025, in Washington, D.C.Andrew Harnik via Getty Images
 "And Trump hired [Homan] after that," Kimmel pointed out.
 "JD, while you're sniffing around for this corruption, that happened in Texas, which is now a blue state. So get in there and investigate!" Kimmel joked. "That's a hot lead!"
 Buzz: 'In Case The President's Wondering': Jimmy Kimmel Nails Trump With Epic Reality Check 
 He added, "While you're at it, Mississippi, South Carolina, Georgia, all blue states now. Pretty soon you might even be headed to Alaska! Who knows?"
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Kimmel couldn't help but rub a little salt in Vance's wound.
 "Wouldn't you love to know how pissed JD Vance was when this [landed]! He almost had a real job to do, he was so close," Kimmel concluded. "You know, I miss the time when if America needed to send someone to talk to our enemies, we sent Dennis Rodman. Where is he?"
